post.title: [Hiring] Paid part-time contract: build AI + health features at an early-stage health-tech startup (fully remote, flexible, ownership)
post.body:
We’re a small, early-stage health-tech startup, and we’re looking for one sharp CS student to join us on a paid, part-time contract. This isn’t a “fix the button colour” gig. You’d be the second engineer on a product that’s live with customers, and you’d help decide what it becomes.

What we do

We are a preventative diagnostics platform for pets. Customers book online, get a sample collected at a clinic, and receive their results in our mobile app with AI-powered insights reviewed by a clinician. Customers are already using the full flow, we have partnerships with clinics and a major diagnostic lab, and our B2B model has clinics paying us on a recurring basis.

What you’d work on

We have a long list of high-impact problems and not enough hands:

* Health scores. Turn raw bloodwork into a clear, trackable health score that people actually understand.
* AI features. Expand our AI layer: lab result summaries, an always-on assistant for customers and clinic staff, and a unified health data model.
* Onboarding, end to end. Rebuild the signup flow and lifecycle emails, and bring at-home kit tracking into the app so customers know exactly where things stand before their clinic or mobile visit.
* Core product. Take the features we’ve only scratched the surface of and make them great.
* Speed. Ship the smaller fixes that are currently taking us way longer than they should.

Why this is worth your time

* Paid. This is real, paid work, and there’s room to grow into a bigger role for the right person.
* Real ownership. You’d own features end to end, from idea to production.
* A seat at the table. We want a thought partner, not just someone writing code. You’d work directly with the founding team on product and technical decisions.
* Resume-defining work. Applied AI on real medical data, a live mobile app, and integrations with real lab partners. These make good stories in your next co-op interview.
* Fully remote and flexible. Work from anywhere, on a schedule that fits around school and co-op.

Who we’re looking for

* Comfortable shipping in a real codebase.
* Interested in or experienced with LLMs and building AI-powered products.
* Self-directed. You’d rather figure it out and ship than wait for a spec.
* Interest in health or health data is a plus, but not required.

How to apply

DM me with:

1. A line or two about yourself
2. Your GitHub, portfolio, or something you’ve built that you’re proud of
3. Your rough availability
4. Your email

Happy to answer questions in the comments!
